title: RECONTEXTUALIZATION MITIGATES SPECIFICATION GAMING WITHOUT MODIFYING THE SPECIFICATION
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical AI alignment, specifically mitigating specification gaming and sycophancy in LLMs through a method called recontextualization. While it evaluates sycophancy (truthfulness vs. pleasing the user), it treats this as a reward-specification failure in RL rather than benchmarking religious, spiritual, or formal ethical/moral frameworks.
